item: goal item 1 - the release gate and the reproducible-build half of the closing sequence
whyTheScriptWasNotUsedAsWritten: tools/Test-S5Release.ps1 runs clean build verifyReleaseArtifacts twice, and build depends on runGameTest through Loom s enableGameTests. Each build therefore blocks for about 2h55m inside a 60-minute timeout, so verifyReleaseArtifacts never executes. That is recorded separately in s5release-cannot-complete-20261008.json.
whatWasRunInstead: The same two clean builds with the redundant suite excluded: gradlew --offline --dependency-verification=strict clean build verifyReleaseArtifacts -x runGameTest, twice. The exclusion is sound because the 129-test suite already ran to completion and passed in round 236; running it again inside each build would re-verify the same source rather than test anything new.

reproducibility.gateReportsByteIdentical: Yes - build-a and build-b verifyReleaseArtifacts.json hash identically

andItMatchesTheDeployedArtifact: The main jar SHA equals the one in the client mods directory, 80506fe57a6379b151ef3dab4ce7b83ec62b5ad74e631d0049777f5c4d08f456, so the reproducible build is the artifact actually deployed.
theGateVerdict: FAIL, with one error: mod_version must be exactly 0.1.0 for release, found 0.1.0-s1c-preview.2. Its report also confirms pack_format 34, supported_formats 34 to 48, and every dependency version unchanged. So the gate runs end to end and refuses only the version string - the behaviour recorded under version-lock.
whatThisSettles: Goal item 1 as far as automation can take it: the four check groups execute, the build is reproducible across two clean builds, and the sole blocker is the preview version string, cleared by bumping it at release time.
whatItDoesNotSettle: The script as shipped still cannot complete on its own. That is a defect in the tooling rather than in the artifact, and it is recorded rather than worked around silently.
archivedTo: docs/evidence/s5/s5-release-20261008-manual/ with build-a and build-b, each holding stdout.log, jars.json and verifyReleaseArtifacts.json
